title: Watch: Why rescuers fear new barrier lake could cause another Nepal-Tibet flood
description: Laura Bicker explains how a lake which formed after the recent landslide near the Nepal-Tibet border is raising fears of a second flood.

title: Disorder at balloon release for man who died in A66 car crash 'put lives at risk', MP says
description: Footage shows cars being set on fire during an event for one of the young men who died in A66 crash.

title: BBC tracks one week of Israeli settler violence in occupied West Bank
description: The BBC's Lucy Williamson reports on settler attacks on Palestinians, which have been observed over the last week alone.
